Maria (security): Heads-up — planning a base image rebuild for staging this Thu 09:00 PT. Need to preflight RBAC, audit logging, and KMS signing rotation.
Jordan (eng-infra): Got it. Scope? full rootfs refresh or minimal patch layer?
Maria (security): Rootfs refresh + remove a few unused pkgs, bump glibc and openssl. Target: runtime-base:1.4 -> runtime-base:1.5.
Lee (runtime): Will require draining a couple nodepools for canary. Any SA changes expected?
Maria (security): Prefer minimal SA churn. But we are introducing a new KMS key alias for image signing: `projects/redwood/kms/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/staging-rotate`.
Anita (SRE): Audit forwarding question — we need explicit DATA_ACCESS logs for KMS Sign operations. Can we ensure those are exported to Splunk/ES?
Jordan (eng-infra): Yes — I'll add a logsink filter for `protoPayload.methodName:"cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign"` and route to our splunk index.
devops-bot: Reminder: run `./scripts/image-preflight.sh staging` before the cutover :robot_face:
Maria (security): Quick IAM question — builder SA currently has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`. For cosign KMS signing do we need `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` or something else?
Lee (runtime): From prior runs, cosign KMS needs the ability to call SignBlob equivalents. Usually `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` does it. Also if we impersonate a SA, `iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` matters.
Jordan (eng-infra): Confirmed. Grant `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` to the GKE builder SA and `iam.serviceAccountUser` for any ephemeral impersonation flows. I'll create a short-lived grant and remove it after the window.
Maria (security): Also want to keep a fallback: accept images signed by previous key for 2 hours post-rollout. Runtime should validate both pubkeys.
Lee (runtime): I'll add dual-key acceptance behind a feature flag. Validation logic will look for either key thumbprint.
Maria (security): Example RBAC snippet I'm going to propose in the PR:
```yaml
- members:
  - serviceAccount:builder-staging@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  role: roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier
```
Jordan (eng-infra): LGTM. I'll create the PR and a short runbook.
Anita (SRE): Failure modes: if signing fails mid-rollout we should: (1) halt rollout, (2) allow runtime to accept old key, (3) trigger incident with tag `image-rebuild`. sec-oncall will triage.
sec-oncall: Acknowledged. If CVE pops during rebuild, tag P0/P1 as usual and prefix with `image-rebuild` so we can track.
Maria (security): Action items: 1) Jordan - create KMS key + PR for IAM by EOD; 2) Lee - implement dual-key acceptance + canary; 3) Anita - ensure audit sink and alerting; 4) Maria - RBAC revocation playbook and post-cutover revoke.
Jordan (eng-infra): I'll aim to get the PR and terraform diff up in next 3 hours.
Lee (runtime): I'll push a tiny canary change to runtime repo and wire the feature flag. Will ping here when the canary is live.
Maria (security): Thanks all. If someone can't make the window DM me; otherwise we'll proceed with the plan. :thumbsup:
